title: Order of Service
intro: What runs in each service, from the working schedules in Notion.

services.title: Wednesday Night · Windermere

items.title: Leader huddle and hangout
items.detail: Hangout runs 6:00–6:30. Assign huddle coverage so arriving students are still welcomed.

checklist: Confirm the run of show, message, worship, games, and small-group guide.
Confirm adult coverage, serving roles, check-in, and first-time guest connections.
Test slides, audio, microphones, and media before students arrive.
Capture attendance, first-time guests, wins, and follow-ups.
services.source: Student Ministry Dashboard · Middle School Sunday Announcements Log

services.title: Wednesday Night · Lakeside
services.note: Clock times for Lakeside aren't posted yet.

services.title: Sunday · Middle School · Windermere

items.title: Tech call
items.detail: Test the room, sound, slides, and check-in.

items.title: Five-minute team huddle
items.detail: Keep an entry greeter in position.

items.title: Welcome and check-in ready
items.detail: Guest Experience sets up the iPads and tables. Connect every arrival to a person.

items.title: Game
items.detail: From Download Youth Ministry, run in Sidekick. Tables answer together on whiteboards.

items.title: Table devotionals
items.detail: 25 minutes, same structure as the message.

items.title: Transition
items.detail: Help students transition per parent arrangements and church policy; offer connection to 11:00 worship.

items.title: Reset and five-minute debrief
items.detail: One win · Anyone we missed? · One issue to fix · Assign an owner and follow-up date · Pray.

checklist: By Thursday: confirm the Sunday lead, welcome and check-in, tech, table leaders, and backups.
services.note: No worship set in the middle school room on Sunday mornings.
services.source: Middle School Sunday Morning Flow · Student Ministry Dashboard
